text:
anna (prod-designer): Quick design review — the rules editor preview feels visually heavy once you hit 6–8 rules. The shaded 'slab' that shows simulated traffic looks like a progress bar and people are confusing it with rule completion. Thoughts?
mike (frontend): +1. The filled bars read like progress. Could we make them thinner and add explicit % labels to the right? Keep color but change affordance.
devin (pm): Also noticed validation copy: when two rules overlap we show 'Conflicting rule'. That's vague for customers. Suggest: 'Rule A overlaps with Rule B — adjust target or priority.'
rachit (engineer): Implementation note: if we shrink the visual bars, we lose hit area for drag handles. Need to keep a 24px tappable area for accessibility.
anna (prod-designer): Good flag. Proposal: reduce fill height but keep a wider invisible handle area on the left. I'll sketch. Link: https://framer.mock/up/preview-slab (wip)
aria-bot: :warning: Accessibility bot: color contrast check — current green (#2ECC71) on white = 2.9:1 for 14px text. Fails AA.
devin (pm): Ugh. We should use token neutral-800 for text overlays, and pick a darker fill token for bars.
mike (frontend): Quick a11y nit: keyboard reorder focus ring disappears when the simulation overlay is open. The overlay has pointer-events:none but steals focus visually.
anna (prod-designer): Copy tweak for the preview header: current 'Simulate traffic' -> propose 'Preview simulated traffic (avg/minute)'. Also add a tooltip: 'Weights show relative priority; higher weight = more traffic routed.'
devin (pm): Suggest microcopy for validation states. Paste below — keep short and actionable:
```
- Overlap detected: "Rule 'Staging' overlaps with 'Default'. Set distinct targets or adjust priority."
- Invalid target: "Target contains unsupported region 'eu-west-9' — remove or edit target."
- Unsaved changes: "You have unsaved changes. Run a preview to validate." 
```
mike (frontend): For CSS tokens I'll start with these vars: `--rule-handle-size: 24px; --rule-bar-height: 8px; --rule-gap: 10px;` Keeps hit area but reduced visual weight.
rachit (engineer): Perf/consistency: compute preview weights client-side as `(priorityWeight / sum(weights)) * 100` and memoize by rule id to avoid reflows. Need stable rule ids for that.
anna (prod-designer): UX detail: add a tiny 'i' tooltip next to each weight showing formula and example. Also toggle to show absolute sample counts (e.g., 12 req/min) vs %.
devin (pm): Also propose changing the badge copy on high-priority rules from 'High' to 'Priority: High' — clearer for support screenshots.
aria-bot: :white_check_mark: Accessibility suggestion: increase contrast on small text to 4.5:1 and ensure drag handle meets 44px min target area on touch.
mike (frontend): I'll mock up the thinner bars + right-aligned % + preserved handle. Expect PR for styles and keyboard fixes tomorrow morning.
anna (prod-designer): I'll update comps and upload new Figma page. Will include a11y token swaps and copy changes.
devin (pm): Who can pair on finalizing the microcopy + a11y checks? I can take copy ownership, someone from eng to confirm constraints.
rachit (engineer): I can pair for 30m after standup. Happy to review ID stability and memoization.
anna (prod-designer): Awesome — thanks all. I'll post updated frames and microcopy here when ready. :sparkles:
